definitions: A shade of colour, usually a mix of blue and green, most often similar to the colour cyan, though also sometimes closer to turquoise or aquamarine.

blocks.text: Vitale is an Italian surname and given name which derives from the Latin word Vita meaning 'life'. The name may refer to:

items: Bobby Vitale, American porn film actor
Carol Vitale (1946–2008), American model and television hostess
Eletise Leafa Vitale, Samoan government minister who plotted and carried out an assassination
Falaniko Vitale, American mixed martial arts fighter
Joe Vitale, American ice hockey player
John Vitale (1965–2000), American college football player
John Vitale (mobster) (1909–1982), American mobster from St Louis
Joseph Vitale (politician), American politician from New Jersey
Leafa Vitale (contemporary), Samoan government minister who plotted an assassination
Leonardo Vitale (1941–1984), Sicilian Mafia member who became an informant
Louie Vitale (1932–2023), American Catholic priest; cofounder of the Nevada Desert Experience
Ottavio Vitale, Italian-born Albanian Roman Catholic bishop
Salvatore Vitale, American mobster from New York
Salvo Vitale (1943–2025), Italian poet and writer
Thomas Vitale, American television network executive

blocks.text: Aqua is a variation of the color cyan. The normalized color coordinates for the two web colors named aqua and cyan are identical. It was one of the three secondary colors of the RGB color model used on computer and television displays. In the HSV color wheel aqua is precisely halfway between blue and green. However, aqua is not the same as the primary subtractive color named process cyan used in printing.
